Vitiligo.description: A condition where white patches of skin appear due to the loss of pigment. It can occur anywhere on the body and may spread over time.
example: I have white patches on my hands and face.
The skin around my elbows has turned pale.

Scabies.description: An itchy, contagious skin condition caused by tiny mites burrowing into the skin. It causes rashes, blisters, and intense itching.
example: I've been itching a lot, especially at night.
There are red spots between my fingers.

Hives (Urticaria).description: Raised, red, itchy welts on the skin, often caused by an allergic reaction. The welts can vary in size and shape.
example: I have swollen, itchy hives on my arms.
My skin is breaking out in red welts after eating something spicy.

Folliculitis.description: An infection of hair follicles, often appearing as red, inflamed bumps or pimples. It can cause itching and tenderness.
example: I have small red pimples around my hair follicles.
My scalp is inflamed and itchy.

Eczema.description: A chronic condition that causes the skin to become inflamed, itchy, and dry. It can lead to redness and scaling, especially on the hands, elbows, and knees.
example: My skin is always dry and itchy, especially in winter.
I have eczema on my hands and elbows.

Ringworm (Tinea Corporis).description: A fungal infection that creates ring-shaped, red, itchy patches on the skin. It is contagious and can spread to other areas of the body.
example: I have a circular rash with a red border.
There's a scaly, itchy patch on my arm that looks like a ring.

Athlete's Foot (Tinea Pedis).description: A fungal infection affecting the feet, often causing itching, burning, and cracked skin, particularly between the toes.
example: My feet are itchy, and the skin is peeling between my toes.
I have red, flaky skin on the soles of my feet.

Rosacea.description: A chronic skin condition that causes redness and visible blood vessels, primarily on the face. It may include pimples and bumps.
example: My face often looks flushed, especially around the cheeks.
I have red bumps and pimples on my nose.

Psoriasis.description: A chronic autoimmune condition that speeds up the production of skin cells, leading to red, scaly patches, often on the elbows, knees, and scalp.
example: I have thick, silvery scales on my elbows.
My scalp is covered in dry, flaky patches.

Shingles (Herpes Zoster).description: A painful rash caused by the reactivation of the chickenpox virus. It often appears as a band of blisters, typically on one side of the body.
example: I have a painful rash along one side of my torso.
There are blisters forming on my back and chest.

Impetigo.description: A contagious bacterial skin infection, usually appearing as red sores that rupture and form a yellow-brown crust.
example: I have yellow crusty sores around my nose and mouth.
There are red sores on my arms that have a yellow crust.

Contact Dermatitis.description: A skin reaction caused by contact with an irritant or allergen, leading to redness, itching, and inflammation.
example: My skin is red and irritated after using a new soap.
I developed a rash after touching poison ivy.

Acne.description: A skin condition characterized by pimples, blackheads, and cysts, typically on the face, chest, and back. It occurs when hair follicles are clogged.
example: I have lots of pimples on my forehead and cheeks.
My back is covered with blackheads and cysts.
